BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents, The Dublin Property Experts, are delighted to present 136 Mount Garrett Park to the Tyrrelstown property market.

This well-presented three-bedroom home offers bright, spacious accommodation throughout, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, growing families, or investors alike.

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hallway leading to the well-appointed kitchen. To the rear of the property, the generously proportioned open-plan living and dining area is flooded with natural light from three large windows, creating a bright and inviting living space. A conveniently located guest bathroom completes the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, the property comprises three spacious double bedrooms along with a modern family bathroom, offering comfortable living space for the whole family.

The location is second to none, with Tyrrelstown Village just minutes away, providing a wide range of shops, cafés, schools, and local amenities. The property enjoys excellent connectivity, with Dublin Airport approximately 20 minutes away and easy access to Clonee, Dunboyne, Clonsilla, Blanchardstown Village, and Blanchardstown Shopping Centre. Nearby employment hubs include the corporate parks of Dublin 15 and Connolly Hospital. Phoenix Park and Castleknock Village are also within a short drive.

The property benefits from an excellent selection of both primary and secondary schools in the surrounding area. Regular public transport links provide easy access to Dublin City Centre, while the nearby M50 and M3 motorways ensure convenient commuting throughout Dublin and beyond.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this excellent home has to offer.

Prospective purchasers should satisfy themselves as to the accuracy of all details through their own independent inspections and due diligence. Dixon Residential Estate Agents accepts no liability for any errors, omissions, or inaccuracies contained herein.
